_comment: 1300 Manhattan Ave (CPA 23-037A). Sources are DXF exports of the OVERVIEW sheets A-100..A-109 only; the a/b sheets are the same model cropped to one section. Set source_dir to the folder holding the exported DXFs or pass --src.

auto_boundary._comment: Draft slab outline per floor: these layers are rasterised on a 0.5 ft grid, gaps up to close_ft are bridged, slivers thinner than open_ft removed, the outer ring traced. close_ft 1: wider notches (the party wall between two balconies, 1.5 ft) stay open so the balconies come out as rectangles; raise it only if a floor leaks (area collapses). Balconies are included; the engineer splits them to ADDITIONAL-LOAD and cuts openings.
auto_boundary._snap_note: Tiers in order of trust; each becomes a review layer RV-EDGE-<name> in the working DXF. FLOR: the architect's floor edge (Revit floor lines, balcony outlines). WALL: the exterior wall face where the edge is hidden under a wall. RAIL: guardrail outlines, last, so a Juliet guardrail a foot outside the wall does not pull the edge out at every window bay; it still catches a balcony front that has no floor line. The engineer deletes candidates that are not slab edge and draws missing ones, then `close` fits the loops exactly.

auto_walls._note: The architect pochés concrete walls on A-WALL-PATT: 8 to 12 in bands on Stairs 1-4, the PE#1/SE#1 shafts and the garage retaining walls. Each band outline becomes a closed WALL polyline, placed with the columns of the plan below.

_columns_note: Architectural plans show the columns standing on a floor, which carry the slab above. So the 11th slab (amenity roof + SL2) takes the 116 columns drawn on the 10th plan, the 10th takes the 9th's, and so on. Range plans (4-5) use their own columns as the typical floor. The lowest floor in hand uses its own until A-107/A-108 arrive.
_datum_note: Insert point of the PE#1 elevator label; identical on every sheet A-100..A-106. If the engineer cuts the elevator shaft out of BOUNDARY as an opening, move this a few feet onto the corridor slab (same offset on every floor is automatic).
